content: No official Go SDK in the agentclientprotocol GitHub org (verified by enumerating all 15 repos: kotlin/java/python/rust/typescript SDKs only). Official site agentclientprotocol.com lists a Community libraries page with 7 Go libs; strongest is coder/acp-go-sdk v0.20.0 (published 2026-11-18, pkg.go.dev confirmed): schema-generated from ACP schema 1.25.0 (wire protocolVersion=1), both AgentSideConnection and ClientSideConnection, JSON-RPC 2.0 one-object-per-line over any io.Reader/Writer (stdio), zero external deps, Go 1.21 min, Apache-2.0, 256 stars, imported by 18 packages, v0.20.0 documented as consolidating all planned API breaks. Alternatives: ironpark/acp-go (schema 1.32.0, draft v2, 36 stars, no releases, encoding/json/v2, Go 1.27+), BrokkAi/acp-go (schema v1.29.1, 2 stars, no releases).
